demand: Expose AIChat-NG/aichat as a fourth document-chat CLI backend.

rivals.DIRECT_DEDICATED: A dedicated C++ AIChatProvider implementation owns AIChat-NG mechanics.
rivals.INVERT_SPEC: A reusable C++ external-CLI provider owns mechanics and consumes a typed AIChat-NG specification instance.

common_functional_contract: discover aichat.exe or aichat on PATH
transmit the exact document path with -f
transmit the exact user prompt as one argument
transmit configured model with -m when non-empty
transmit the generated session id with -s
recover arbitrarily chunked UTF-8 assistant stdout without loss
surface a non-zero child exit as an error
surface a NUL-containing output stream as invalid instead of silent success
minimality_rule: Existing Claude, Grok, and Codex behavior must remain unchanged; no downstream SumatraPDF implementation bytes and no P9 DIRECT implementation bytes may be used.
comparability_stop: If either arm cannot satisfy this exact contract with a buildable minimally scoped change, stop as NONCOMPARABLE.
